issues.actualPhase: Phase 1 - Should have been caught earlier
issues.description: Database connection failure - all API endpoints returning 500 errors
issues.detailedDescription: All /api/ipos endpoints are failing with 'DatabaseError: Failed to fetch IPO list'. No IPO data can be retrieved from the database, blocking all testing.
issues.rootCause: Database not accessible or not running. Possible causes: (1) PostgreSQL service not running, (2) DATABASE_URL incorrect, (3) Database not seeded with data, (4) Network/firewall issue

issues.description: React hydration mismatch error on homepage
issues.detailedDescription: Server-rendered HTML doesn't match client-side render in the Header navigation component, specifically around the Tools dropdown. This causes React to re-render the component on the client.
issues.rootCause: Conditional rendering or dynamic content between server and client. Likely caused by: (1) typeof window check, (2) Date.now() or Math.random(), (3) Browser-specific API usage in SSR component
